name: VersaBank VUSD
oneLiner: VUSD is VersaBank USA’s dollar deposit token, piloted as USDVB and issued one-for-one against deposits; its U.S. commercial phase began October 15, 2026.
collateral: Pre-launch bank deposit token: one VUSD represents US$1 on deposit with VersaBank USA National Association. This is exposure to a bank deposit and its balance sheet, not a separately segregated 100%-cash reserve trust. VersaBank's 15 October 2026 release calls VUSD FDIC insurance-eligible without naming a regulator decision.
pegMechanism: The USDVB pilot issues one token per US$1 deposited with VersaBank USA, with issuance and redemption through VersaVault and access/control through VersaView on planned Algorand, Ethereum and Stellar deployments. Ordinary external-holder transfer and redemption rights, minimums, fees, timing and capacity are unpublished.
launchPhaseDetail: Internal USDVB pilot announced August 26, 2025, with limited designated external deposit-partner/client deployment planned. Pilot is not a supported catalog launch-phase enum, so no launchPhase is assigned. The bank had described commercial launch as subject to an OCC non-objection process, and its September 1, 2026 filing sought regulatory confirmation of deposit-insurance eligibility and the ability to pay interest. On October 1 2026 VersaBank said VersaBank USA is serving as issuer of Bank of North Dakota's Roughrider Coin, live on Fiserv's digital asset platform, with responsibility for minting, burning, custody and reserve asset management. On October 15 2026 VersaBank announced the US commercial phase, under which VersaBank USA is to issue VUSD, a tokenized deposit the release calls interest-paying and FDIC insurance-eligible. The release says the phase is in full compliance with U.S. federal banking regulations and cites recent certainty around the bank's compliance, but names no regulator decision, chain or date. Pharos tracks the commercial token as VUSD from October 15 2026; USDVB remains the pilot name. No current launch window or official chain-qualified asset addresses are established.

featuredContent.title: VersaBank Initiates Commercial Phase of Tokenized Deposit Program in the United States
featuredContent.description: VersaBank's October 15 2026 release announcing that VersaBank USA will issue VUSD, a U.S. dollar tokenized deposit the bank describes as interest-paying and FDIC insurance-eligible, with exchange listings planned as soon as feasible.

milestones.title: VersaBank USA launches internal USDVB pilot
milestones.description: The bank describes phased testing and limited external partner/client expansion before commercialization, with one USDVB per US$1 on deposit.

milestones.title: Quarterly filing retains conditional tokenized-deposit strategy
milestones.description: The bank seeks regulatory confirmation of insurance eligibility and the ability to pay interest; the filing does not establish a public USDVB commercial launch.

milestones.title: VersaBank USA becomes issuer of Bank of North Dakota's Roughrider Coin
milestones.description: VersaBank said its subsidiary VersaBank USA, N.A. is serving as issuer of Roughrider Coin on Fiserv's digital asset platform, responsible for minting, burning, custody and reserve asset management, with Solana and Fireblocks named as supporting partners. The release calls Roughrider a stablecoin for bank-to-bank payments and does not mention VUSD or USDVB.

milestones.title: VersaBank announces the US commercial phase of its tokenized deposits with VUSD
milestones.description: VersaBank said VersaBank USA will issue VUSD, a US dollar tokenized deposit it describes as interest-paying and FDIC insurance-eligible, and plans exchange listings as soon as feasible. The release names no blockchain or launch date and describes the bank as moving toward launch.
